title: Quick Purple Pickle
description: Thinly sliced red onion quickly pickled in red wine vinegar, salt and sugar until vividly pink and softened.
steps: In a small bowl, combine the red onion, vinegar, salt and sugar.
Mix well, making sure the onion is fully coated.
Leave for at least 30 minutes (the longer the better) before serving — the onion will turn a vivid pink colour and soften slightly.
notes: Wonderful alongside the Fakeaway Doner Kebab, Chipotle-Spiced Chicken Tinga and Chilli Bean Pie. Will keep in the refrigerator for a few days in an airtight jar. Prep time excludes at least 30 minutes resting.
